findings.summary: Scripts reference `drizzle-kit migrate`, `dist/main.js`, `dist/seed/main.js` — forward references to files that downstream tasks will create; harmless at scaffold time but `pnpm start` and `pnpm seed` will fail until task-app-main + task-seed land
